high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from the website "glassalmanac.com." The content discusses the sale of an original Apple I computer from 1976 at an auction for $375,000 (approximately 354,000 euros). The auction was hosted by RR Auction. The text highlights that despite its age, the computer is fully operational and has been restored to working condition by a specialist in vintage Apple products back in October 2019. It mentions that the device comes with all necessary components and accessories for operation, including a rare and extensively annotated original user manual.
